title: Varg i Veum, Investigate Before You Decide
concept: The enemy is premature interpretation, not uncertainty itself.
review_reason: Contains symbolic violent-response panel (shoot immediately) and must be framed as anti-premature-judgment doctrine, not behavioral instruction.
notes: Poster 3 of 3 in the revised POC-08 series. Canonical Varg i Veum artifact with six-step cycle.
